info.description: ActorBase is an acting engine for drama writing and performance. POST /perform performs a line as acted speech (MP3 plus the delivery notes and the segment-by-segment performance plan). POST /table-read performs a whole scene with one distinct voice per speaker and returns a measured per-line timing map. POST /character returns an actor's character build: objective, super-objective, obstacles, tactics in action verbs, backstory beats, voice and physicality notes. POST /three-reads performs the same line three genuinely different ways (different tactic and subtext each) so a writer can hear which read lands. POST /scene-notes analyzes a scene for beats, turns, subtext and power shifts. Delivery is computed in code from a fixed emotion-by-intensity table; durations are measured from the audio frames. Voices are stock synthesis voices under generic craft archetypes (ingenue, villain, matriarch, trickster); no real actor is imitated. Every failure is a structured JSON error, including an explicit 503 when the reasoning engine is not configured.
info.title: ActorBase

post.description: JSON body: description (required, up to 2,000 characters), name (optional), play_context (optional). Returns the build in working acting vocabulary: objective and super-objective as action sentences, obstacles, tactics as action verbs with phrases, backstory beats, given circumstances, voice notes and physicality notes. The response shape is validated in code; an unusable engine result is a 502, never padded with invented craft.

200.description: character {name, objective, super_objective, obstacles[], tactics[], backstory_beats[], given_circumstances[], voice_notes, physicality_notes}, _meta

401.description: Missing or invalid RapidAPI proxy secret

503.description: Structured error: engine_not_configured (reasoning engine key not yet added)

post.summary: Build a character the way an actor prepares one

200.description: status, service, version, build, engines {reasoning, performance}, delivery_table, personas, limits, endpoints, recent_requests, note

get.summary: Service status, engine states, delivery table, personas, limits

post.description: JSON body: text (required, up to 2,000 characters; mark emphasis with *asterisks*), emotion (optional: neutral, joy, anger, grief, fear, tenderness, contempt, resolve, awe, guilt), intensity (optional integer 1-5, default 3), voice (optional Edge voice id), persona (optional archetype: ingenue, leading-lady, leading-man, young-hero, matriarch, patriarch, villain, trickster, confidante, narrator). Explicit fields override the persona. Prosody comes from the fixed delivery table in code. Returns the MP3 base64-encoded with the delivery used, the full segment plan with measured durations, and the plan as an SSML-style score.

200.description: audio_base64, audio_format, duration_s, voice, persona, emotion, intensity, delivery {rate, pitch, volume, beat_pause_ms}, delivery_plan[], score, characters, note, _meta

401.description: Missing or invalid RapidAPI proxy secret

422.description: Structured error: missing_parameter, text_too_long or invalid_parameter

502.description: Structured error: synthesis_failed (a segment failed after retries; no partial performance is returned)

503.description: Structured error: engine_not_configured (performance package not installed on the deployment)

post.description: JSON body: scene_text (required, up to 12,000 characters, standard scene format works best). Returns beats in scene order (what changes, where it turns, the subtext), power shifts (where, from whom, to whom), per-character wants / hides / tactics, and a summary of what the scene is really about.

200.description: beats[] {beat, turn, subtext}, power_shifts[] {where, from, to}, characters {name: {wants, hides, tactics[]}}, summary, _meta

401.description: Missing or invalid RapidAPI proxy secret

503.description: Structured error: engine_not_configured (reasoning engine key not yet added)

post.summary: Acting analysis of a scene: beats, subtext, power shifts

post.description: JSON body: lines (required array, up to 40, of {speaker, line, direction?, emotion?, intensity?, pause_after_ms?}) and cast (required object, up to 12, mapping each speaker to a voice id, a persona name, or a casting object {voice?, persona?, emotion?, intensity?}). Total line text up to 8,000 characters. Free-text directions are interpreted into the delivery vocabulary when the reasoning engine is configured, and carried uninterpreted (with a warning) when it is not. Returns one stitched MP3 and a timing map measured from the audio frames.

200.description: audio_base64, audio_format, duration_s, timing_map[] {index, speaker, line, voice, persona, emotion, intensity, direction, direction_interpreted, start_s, end_s, duration_s, pause_after_ms}, cast, warnings[], note, _meta

401.description: Missing or invalid RapidAPI proxy secret

422.description: Structured error: missing_parameter (including an uncast speaker), invalid_parameter, text_too_long or too_many_lines

post.description: JSON body: line (required, up to 400 characters), context (optional, up to 1,000), voice or persona (optional; one instrument for all three reads).
